chapter: Three Deuces and 52nd Street with Tatum
title: Oscar Moore and Floyd Smith as guitarists
summary: He remembers Oscar Moore and Floyd Smith; he heard Smith rehearse and met him much later in Atlantic City but was not influenced by him.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: --- Oscar Moore, excellent guitar player --- Floyd Smith was an excellent guitar player. He was with Andy Kirk a long time. I got in trouble trying to play his blues. learn how to play his blues ---
When did you first meet Floyd Smith?
--- I went to one of there rehearsals and just listened, you know, Admired his playing. He was colorful. But I never
met him to really know him. Not until long time --- Atlantic City then I knew him fairly good, cause he played up the street.
